## What changed?

Describe the user-visible behavior and the reason for the change.

## How was it verified?

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run check:functions` (backend changes)
- [ ] `npm run functions:test:rules` (Rules/data changes)
- [ ] `npm run check:rust` (native changes)
- [ ] Manual macOS and/or Windows test where relevant

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, raw dictation content, or production identifiers were added
- [ ] Permission, storage, network, billing, and logging changes are documented
- [ ] Screenshots contain no private information
